Labaika A. (Owner @ Womersley Foods | Making every day meal taste extraordinary!)
✨ Exciting news! ✨

Our award-winning and best-selling Fruit & Herb Vinegars have arrived at Selfridges, now presented in a beautiful new look and convenient 250ml bottle size, with exactly the same deliciously versatile flavours you know and love.

From drizzling over salads and roasted vegetables to creating vibrant marinades, cocktails and desserts, these artisan vinegars are made to inspire creativity in every kitchen.

We are incredibly proud to see a selected range of our vinegars on the shelves of Selfridges, and we are grateful for every customer who chooses to support our small family business along the way. ❤️

If you are visiting Selfridges, keep an eye out for Womersley Foods and discover why our Fruit & Herb Vinegars have become award-winning favourites for professional chefs and home cooks.

Have you spotted them yet? Let us know in the comments and tag us in your Selfridges finds!👇
